about.heading: About me
about.paragraph1: Iballa | Registered Dietitian, BSc (Hons) Biomedical Science, MSc Human Nutrition and Dietetics
about.paragraph2: I am a CORU-registered dietitian with extensive experience in weight management, women's health and gut health. I hold a BSc in Biomedical Science, specialising in Clinical Biochemistry and Medical Microbiology, and an MSc in Human Nutrition and Dietetics, with additional specialist training in IBS management and women's health.
about.paragraph3: I am a proud member of the Irish Nutrition and Dietetic Institute (INDI), where I am part of the Women's Health Interest Group. I worked as a clinical dietitian in the health services in Ireland and Australia before founding Nutrition By Iballa in early 2026.
about.paragraph4: My own experience with PMOS, gut health and weight management has given me a personal understanding of how frustrating and overwhelming these issues can feel. It shapes the empathy and practical insight I bring to my work.
about.paragraph5: My aim is to give you the tools and guidance you need as you begin your health journey, always grounding my advice in scientific evidence and solutions that work long term. I don't believe in quick fixes. Instead, I want to help you build lifelong habits that fit your lifestyle. Every consultation is a safe, judgement-free space where we can work together at your own pace.
about.paragraph6: If you want to chat further, book your discovery call below.

appointments.heading: Bookings
appointments.startHere: Not sure which service you need? Start here.
appointments.mealPlanNote: Meal plans are not included in consultations. Instead, you will receive the tools, knowledge and support to eat flexibly in a way that supports your health.
appointments.missingFreeCallUrl: This free-call booking link will be available once the Calendly URL has been added.
policy: Cancellations and rescheduling: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge with at least 24 hours' notice. Cancellations made within 24 hours of the appointment time, and missed appointments, may be charged in full or counted as a used appointment. This helps us keep availability open for other clients.

Late arrivals: If you are running more than 10 minutes late, we may need to mark the appointment as a no-show and reschedule. This ensures we have enough time together to give you the full attention and support you deserve.

Bundles: Consultations purchased as a bundle must be used within the following timeframes: Bundle of 4 consultations within 6 months of the date of the initial appointment; Bundle of 6 consultations within 12 months of the date of the initial appointment.
Fees are non-refundable once the first consultation has taken place. After you have attended your first session, no refund will be given for any unused consultations remaining in the bundle.

description: Curious if we're a good fit? Book a free, no-pressure discovery call where we'll chat about your health goals, current challenges, and what working together could look like.

initial.title: Initial Consultation
initial.description: In your first appointment, we’ll review your health history, current medications, previous test results, and eating habits. This will help me understand your situation in a comprehensive way and create a nutrition plan tailored to your needs and goals.

review.title: Review Appointment
review.description: In the follow-up appointments, we’ll assess your progress and look for solutions to any challenges that may arise along the way.

items.title: She made me feel heard, understood, and supported
items.review:
I honestly couldn't be happier with my experience. From day one, she made me feel heard, understood, and supported. What I appreciate most is how she takes the time to adapt everything to my individual needs rather than using a one-size-fits-all approach.

Her work goes far beyond nutrition alone. She takes a truly holistic approach to wellbeing, considering not just food, but also lifestyle, habits, balance, and overall health. That has made a huge difference for me. Thanks Iballa

items.title: I’m delighted!
items.review: A true professional, she taught me how to maintain a balanced diet over time. After my digestive diagnosis, she's helping me establish guidelines to improve without drastic restrictions, combining them with basic nutritional advice. I'm delighted!

items.title: Professional nutritionist with extensive experience
items.review:
She showed me the benefits of each food and how to incorporate them into every meal for healthy eating.

Without a doubt, a professional nutritionist with extensive experience.
